newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heavy-truck stocks raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heavy-truck stocks raised.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said it upgraded several heavy-truck stocks to buy from market performer.
-- said believes that heavy-truck orders have improved enough to allow industry production levels to rise as much as 15-20 percent from current levels.
-- said expects truck orders to stay reasonably strong at least through the second quarter.
-- said higher build rates should positively affect earnings.
-- said raised Cummins Engine Co Inc, Detroit Diesel Corp, Navistar International Corp and PACCAR Inc to buy from market performer.
-- said maintained a buy recommendation on Eaton Corp.
